blind.description: A low, rounded mound of stylized gold coins textured with a bumpy cellular pattern. Embedded within the coin heap are several items of loot: a stack of rectangular gold ingots, a dark grey rounded helmet or iron kettle, and a tilted dark grey cauldron or cooking pot filled with gold. Surfaces are solid, smooth, and continuous with no hovering elements, cracks, or detached parts. The bottom sits flat against the floor without any separate plinth or base. Colors are vibrant warm gold and orange-yellow, contrasted by dark charcoal grey metal.
blind.from_above: An irregular, rounded golden mound with a small extension/spill on one side, resembling a lumpy yellow shape embedded with two dark grey circular objects (a dome and a hollow vessel rim) and a cluster of small rectangular golden bars.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 1.5 to 2 feet high (roughly one-third the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about 3.5 to 4 feet wide.
